<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/run/summary"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the caller's campaign runs (parent runs only), newest first, each with its goal verdicts over all its attack runs: how many goals were jailbroken, mitigated or are unresolved. Filter by `campaign`, `agent` or `status`; a malformed id matches nothing. Paginated with `page` and `page_size` (at most 100). This is the dashboard's run list. Accepts a login token or an API key (not a run token). Every response has a weak `ETag`: send it back as `If-None-Match` to get `304` without a body while nothing changed.
